description: This is a controller class in a PHP-based HR management system module, responsible for fixing language string errors within the admin plugin. It handles pre-render logic, verifying language data and preparing a Vue component with relevant properties.

classes.name: FixLanguageStringErrorsController

methods.name: preRender
